label: Statewide EEO foundation
detail: AB 132 established a $20 million one-time EEO Best Practices Fund. Approximately $15.5 million was apportioned to eligible districts in 2021–22.

label: First competitive EEO IBP cycle
detail: The Chancellor’s Office awarded $5,651,806 to 21 districts after adding funding to the competitive grant fund.

label: Current competitive EEO IBP cycle
detail: Eleven districts received awards of $100,000 or $150,000 to advance innovative employment practices.

label: Published competitive awards
detail: Across the two published EEO IBP cycles, CCCCO committed $7,051,806 through 32 district award selections. The statewide apportionment is shown separately to avoid double counting.
